report:
Skin, left axilla abscess wall, excision

Received in formalin are irregular pieces of tan-brown soft tissue labelled left axilla abscess wall, measuring 3 x 2 x 1 cm in aggregate. All embedded in 2 blocks.

(1-2) Tissue pieces, all embedded.

Sections show skin and subcutaneous tissue with dense suppurative inflammation composed of abundant neutrophils, histiocytes and necrotic debris, surrounded by granulation tissue and fibrosis. The findings are in keeping with an abscess wall. There is no evidence of granulomatous inflammation or malignancy.

SKIN, left axilla abscess wall, excision - In keeping with ABSCESS WALL
